No Worries Damage Coverage never explained — said 'insurance' is included but never the $2,000 repair/replace/reimburse coverage or the 60c/lb baseline
Meet Your Mover email never mentioned
Entire Save Your Ass prep speech skipped — no 'prep shortens the move and lowers your bill', no consolidation examples, no carload tip

top_strength: The pricing and clock block was genuinely strong — $208/hr for two movers and a truck, an itemized 'what's included' list (taxes, insurance, pad wrap, disassembly/reassembly, floor and door protection), the no-hidden-fees pitch, and a clean clock explanation with a sense-check by name ('All that makes sense so far... Max'). He also handled the oversized shelf well, asking for a photo and then visibly folding it into the time range.
coaching_note: Add the Save Your Ass prep speech — this call had an easy hook (a 700 sqft apartment with a big disassembly item and stairs) and Nick quoted a wide 4.5-5.5 hour range without ever telling Max that prepping and taking a carload could pull him toward the low end. That one addition also protects estimate accuracy.
phone_presence_notes: Polite and used Max's name four times, but the call was transactional — heavy 'Okay. Okay.' filler, no empathy or warmth markers, and no rapport beyond the task.
